messages:
Devon: RC cut is in ~2h — PR https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/6219 needs a second pair of eyes. Jen has already approved but policy requires 2 reviewers before the cut. If we don't get the second review by cutoff we'll have to postpone the RC.
Jen: I already gave an approval earlier — left one tiny comment about the null path in clone() that isn't blocking.
Maria: I'll take a look in ~20m. Any perf/regression numbers so I know what to focus on?
Devon: Unit + integration ran green on CI. Perf bench shows ~0.9% diff (not statistically significant). Change is removing a legacy kv-cache compatibility shim; main concern is the warmup path in runtime. Need runtime team sanity check.
Sahil: Pulling it up now, will do a focused audit on warmup + KV cache handling. Ping me if you want a fast merge after I sign off.
Sahil: Quick nit: prefer an early return in apply_cache_patch to avoid one nested branch. I can push a 1-line fix if that's acceptable.
Devon: Please push the tiny fix. Cutoff is 15:15 UTC — if we have the 2nd sign-off before then we can cut as planned.
CI-bot: CI: all checks passed ✅ — build #6219 | tests: 1284 passed | perf: baseline +/-0.9% (no regression flagged).
Sahil: LGTM after I push the 1-line change, will push now. :thumbsup:
Devon: Merged at 15:07 UTC, tagging the RC. Thanks everyone! :tada: (Jen reacted with :eyes: on the final merge)
